title: nolana peruviana subsp. divaricata
intro: Nolana peruviana subsp. divaricata, commonly known as Divaricate Nolana, is a species of flowering plant in the family Solanaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, wounds, and inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Divaricate Nolana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help in reducing pain, promoting wound healing, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
